laborForm: hand-harvested from a canoe using knocking sticks and a push pole, within the licensed statewide season (Minnesota DNR, 'Wild Rice Regulations')

liquidity.exitPath: sold directly to a buyer, through a state-licensed wild rice buyer, or processed and sold as a packaged food product by a tribally-owned foods enterprise

extractionCeiling.cap: unknown; no per-harvester poundage cap found for state waters, and reservation wild rice committees set their own harvest rules on reservation waters
extractionCeiling.resetPeriod: annual (statewide season runs August 15 to September 30, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily; reservation committees set their own opening dates and hours no less than 24 hours before opening)
extractionCeiling.antiBotRule: a Minnesota wild-rice harvester license (season or one-day) is required for residents and nonresidents; members of a federally recognized Minnesota tribe with a valid tribal ID card are exempt from the state license

identityCost.detail: a state wild-rice harvester license, or a tribal ID card for exempt tribal members; license and buyer-license fees are deposited in a dedicated wild-rice management account (Minnesota DNR, 'Wild Rice Regulations')

knownProducts.product: hand-harvested raw wild rice grain, parched and finished for food
knownProducts.use: food; higher protein content than most cereal grains, a subsistence and cultural keystone for Anishinaabe communities of the Lake Superior basin, protected by 1837, 1842, and 1854 treaty harvesting rights

knownProducts.product: packaged cultivated and hand-harvested wild rice, wild-fruit jellies, jams, and gift foods
knownProducts.use: retail food product sold under a tribally-owned brand; cited here as the reference-implementation market for Minnesota wild rice, not as evidence that this North Shore territory's own harvest reaches this specific enterprise (Red Lake Nation is a different band's reservation)

markets.buyer: Red Lake Nation Foods (Red Lake Nation's tribally-owned enterprise), cited as the reference-implementation market for hand-harvested and cultivated Minnesota wild rice
